fields: Do Not Start With This When

rows.Main Input: Spatial transcriptomics count object with spatial coordinates and spot-level quality metrics.
rows.Main Use in This Topic: Spatially aware identification of low-quality spots, local QC outliers, and regional artifacts after a spatial count object exists.
rows.Main Output: Annotated or filtered spot set with spatial QC calls, artifact-region evidence, and supporting QC summaries.
rows.Key Difference: Focuses on spatial neighborhood-aware spot and artifact QC rather than end-to-end raw-read preprocessing.
rows.Evidence Note: Direct evidence: PubMed PMID 40481362 and DOI 10.1038/s41592-025-02713-3 verify the method-paper identity and spatially aware QC scope; Bioconductor provides the primary code source. Layer 2 synthesis: comparator choice, memory/scale caution, and the branch role as focused post-count QC.
rows.Best First Choice When: Use first when a spatial count object already exists and the main question is whether spots or tissue regions show spatially structured QC artifacts.
rows.Do Not Start With This When: Do not start here when the main need is raw sequencing-data preprocessing, count generation, or a broad preprocessing pipeline.

rows.Main Input: Sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics raw or near-raw preprocessing inputs, including reads and platform/reference information.
rows.Main Use in This Topic: Preprocessing and quality-control workflow for sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics before or during construction of analysis-ready count objects.
rows.Main Output: Processed spatial expression object, QC metrics, and pipeline-level preprocessing outputs.
rows.Key Difference: Provides a broader upstream preprocessing and QC pipeline rather than a specialized spatial local-outlier or regional-artifact detector.
rows.Evidence Note: Direct evidence: PubMed PMID 41278534 and DOI 10.1093/nargab/lqaf167 verify the method-paper identity and R/Bioconductor preprocessing/QC scope; Bioconductor provides the primary code source. Layer 2 synthesis: comparator choice, resource caution, and its placement as the upstream pipeline branch rather than focused post-count spatial artifact QC.
rows.Best First Choice When: Use first when starting from sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics preprocessing inputs and the immediate need is an organized preprocessing plus QC workflow.
rows.Do Not Start With This When: Do not start here when the count object is already prepared and the main need is spatially aware detection of low-quality spots or regional artifacts.
